name: Perspective-Correct Point Splatting Vertex Shader
definition: A vertex shader that renders point clouds as splats (quads or points) with size attenuation based on perspective projection, ensuring the visual size of points corresponds to their world-space radius.
summary: This vertex shader renders point clouds as splats with perspective-correct size attenuation, differing from conic or clipping methods by using hardware-accelerated rasterization at the primitive level.
